authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04 (eight contract families; SUPPORT-FIRST promoted to program-level mandatory constraint; CD-0 proves NO market conclusions)

forbidden: computing any decision metric on market data
revising state definitions after seeing G0-G5 results
cd0_scope_rule.production_gate: NO NEW PRODUCTION BEFORE CD-0 FREEZE (and CD-1..CD-8 each require their own freeze/GO)

contract_1_decision.rule: any future feature must map to >=1 of the six decisions or it stays out of the production chain (research annexes allowed, production chain closed)

contract_2_pit_provenance.availability_rule: available_at <= decision_time for ALL historical features
contract_2_pit_provenance.sector_membership: versioned (stock, taxonomy, level, valid_from, valid_to, source, available_at); sector_of(stock, T) only; current-label backfill FORBIDDEN
contract_2_pit_provenance.missing_data: FAIL CLOSED: emit INSUFFICIENT_DATA / NO_PIT_DATA states; default value imputation that fabricates a state is FORBIDDEN
contract_2_pit_provenance.provenance: every dataset carries source, retrieval time, and content hash; raw evidence retained for rebuild

contract_3_support_first_PROGRAM_LEVEL.lesson_authority: Phase J (CSR-8): a discrete state with near-zero historical support makes downstream rigor irrelevant — the protocol correctly returns INCONCLUSIVE, but the research question dies anyway
applies_to: L1 market regime (RISK_ON / DEFENSIVE_ACCUMULATION / TACTICAL / RISK_OFF)
prior_census_required_per_state: era concentration (does the state exist only in one era)
contract_3_support_first_PROGRAM_LEVEL.verdict_when_insufficient: INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT — adjusting thresholds, merging states, or switching windows to rescue is FORBIDDEN
contract_3_support_first_PROGRAM_LEVEL.ordering: census FIRST, use SECOND; a state without a frozen census report may not enter any decision or validation artifact

contract_4_sector.hierarchy: three levels frozen (L1 industry / L2 sector / L3 sub-sector), first version targets investment-meaningful granularity, no infinite knowledge graph
contract_4_sector.source_priority: declared in CD-1 freeze before fetching; conflicts resolved by declared priority, never ad hoc
contract_4_sector.cd1_first_question: do we OWN a classification fine enough, historical enough, and with enough support to act as the middle layer — answered by per-level historical coverage census BEFORE any sector-strength computation
contract_4_sector.fragmentation_guard: finer taxonomy => support fragmentation; each level's census must show researchable support before that level is used

contract_5_observable_cost.definition: 'cost' means an OBSERVABLE COST STRUCTURE estimated from transactions, turnover, and public holdings information — NEVER 'real dealer cost'

direct_observation: volume x price成交分布原始统计

contract_5_observable_cost.survival_models: two frozen variants for sensitivity (exp(-k*turnover) and 1-adjusted_turnover), k frozen BEFORE outcomes; tuning k for better outcomes FORBIDDEN
contract_5_observable_cost.naming: production fields use structure language; '庄家' vocabulary forbidden

contract_6_lifecycle.semantics_frozen_now: each state is a capital/chip-structure interpretation (decline stop + turnover + cost concentration + overhang decay patterns), NOT actor intention; _CONSISTENT suffix marks 'consistent with accumulation' rather than asserting an accumulator exists
contract_6_lifecycle.thresholds: NOT frozen here — frozen at CD-5 with prior support census per state; semantic revision after seeing outcomes FORBIDDEN
contract_6_lifecycle.transitions: rule-based, machine-auditable, every transition emits its evidence vector

contract_7_outcome_decision_value.final_judgment_rule: never average return alone; every comparison reports the full family including failure-path metrics
contract_7_outcome_decision_value.no_late_outcome_picking: this family is frozen at CD-0; CD-8 may not add, drop, or re-weight outcomes after seeing results

contract_8_falsification.marginal_contribution_mandatory: EVERY layer delta (Gk - G(k-1)) must be reported, not just G0 vs G5 — a framework propped up by one layer (e.g. sector only) must not masquerade as full-theory success
contract_8_falsification.rescue_ban: if layer-wise additions do not stably improve decision results, adding new variables to rescue the theory is FORBIDDEN
contract_8_falsification.stability_criterion_format_frozen_now: improvement judged on preregistered replay windows; a layer 'stably improves' iff its marginal contribution has consistent direction in >=2/3 of preregistered windows AND median direction matches; the replay-window SET is declared at CD-8 preregistration and this criterion format may not be re-chosen afterwards
contract_8_falsification.final_wording: CD-8 verdict is GO/NO-GO for the practical value of the capital-structure funnel, not for statistical significance

csr8_standing: H IMMUTABLE / I FROZEN / J CLOSED / K NOT STARTED — CSR-8 remains the evidence-and-discipline infrastructure; CD is the new program line
change_control: frozen on commit; append-only erratum + explicit user authorization for any change; state semantics cannot be revised after outcome observation
